description: This PHP source file defines a class 'DetailedProjectActivityReportMenuConfigurator' that implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface for configuring menu screens related to detailed project activity reports within the OrangeHRM time module. It mainly overrides a screen with 'displayProjectReportCriteria'.

classes.name: DetailedProjectActivityReportMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Class for configuring the menu related to detailed project activity reports in the OrangeHRM time module. Implements the 'configure' method to override specific screen settings.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the screen 'displayProjectReportCriteria' within the given Screen object for the detailed project activity report menu.
